passive_skills.description: Rutaco sets up a poison gas mine that explodes when a monster passes by, causing the monster to build up poison value. Once fully built up, the monster is inflicted with the poisoned status. Cooldown: 180s.

passive_skills.name: Rutaco's Turret
passive_skills.description: Rutaco builds a large turret that lasts for 10s, which adventurers can operate to fire up to 3 balloon shells, each dealing damage equal to 9.9% attack, with the final shell dealing damage equal to 19.8% attack. On hit, it causes the monster to stagger, and the monster will enter an enraged state after the stagger ends. Cooldown: 180s.

other_skills.name: Rutaco's Barrage Cannon
other_skills.description: The Rutaco builds an auto-firing turret. After every 2 common shots, it fires 1 additional enhanced shot. Common shots deal damage equal to 1.7% attack, while enhanced shots deal damage equal to 5.1% attack. Landing a shot extends the monster's suppress duration by up to 1.2s.
